name: stock-market-prediction
description: Real-time stock market prediction app with Indian API integration

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm run build

//deps: Must stay in sync with backend/package.json. The Vercel function (api/index.mjs) imports backend/src/**, so these must resolve from the repo root, not only from backend/node_modules.
